quotes.text: I can't live without Magic Storage anymore!
Brilliant! This categorization feature is so good!

For me, though, the cost of using it is really reasonable. I run the full Ayameduki race lineup, plus Ratkin, Milira, MoeLotl, Wolfein, Kiiro and The Dead Man's Switch. Without this cosmic workbench, I couldn't even manage a gravship 😂
highlights: the cost of using it is really reasonable

quotes.text: The logic behind this workbench mod is unbeatable. When I change a bill's crafting requirements, pawns seem to respond tens of thousands of times faster than in vanilla.
highlights: The logic behind this workbench mod is unbeatable.

quotes.text: Yeah, it's mainly that this workbench costs so little to use. The concept and approach are excellent, and its UI and workflow are the best I've seen.
highlights: The concept and approach are excellent

quotes.text: It's such a huge quality-of-life improvement. It makes me feel like my micromanagement skills have improved.

workshop_names.note: Aya series by Ayameduki; full lineup is a translation of the player's wording.
